restart_assessment.sqlite_authority: backend/app/tenderproof/continuous_tasks.py:1 states broker deliveries are hints; every tick constructs a fresh engine, schedules due sources and redispatches ready jobs. No sent flag can permanently lose a broker delivery.
restart_assessment.api: Current TestClient proof accepts durable enqueue without Redis; current child-process test reads committed queue state. Inherited real Celery proof includes another process loading run and PDF. An actual production API-server restart was not performed.
restart_assessment.worker: Actual process death/recovery is proven in inherited Redis/Celery execution and current batch99 13-source completed-result recovery.
restart_assessment.scheduler: Durable redispatch is proven by the inherited real broker tick and current injected dispatch-failure test. A separate Celery beat service restart and wall-clock downtime were not exercised.
restart_assessment.redis: No current full Redis stop/restart experiment. Failure behavior is covered at the broker call boundary and real Redis delivery is inherited. SQLite remains authoritative; no production Redis availability claim.
restart_assessment.judgment: No additional mandatory product defect was found for the stated bounded local/offline acceptance. Actual service orchestration restart, production storage setup and coordinated canonical backup remain deployment validation, not evidence silently supplied by these tests.

counting_notes: Two durable artifact files per source come from the two replay cycles; processing input copies are additional files, not additional notices or sources.

operations_limits: Production collection/publication were not enabled or changed by this audit.
